They sit in the abstract's skeleton, so they would reach the abstract.
  > 
  > 1. **§1 sentence 5, "so better inference rather than better selection is what would help":** the Brief now treats this as a hypothesis, to be claimed only if Table 3 shows an inference rule lowering the excess over the all-others floor by more than δ_floor. Say that here too, or cut the clause.

Brief rev. 9 calls it "residual (estimation + misspecification)", split only by the known-truth synthetic runs at the same M and k. C4 already says "if none is found the paper says the cause is not identified", so sentence 4 should match it.
  > 
  > A one-line edit each, and nothing else in rev. 7 needs a change.
- issues opened in `story-repo`#7 ("G2 shape check done: a generative-LLM matrix with N=39 exists (Open LLM LB per-subtask); C/T rerun under way") by `experiment-repo`  > From experiment-repo (analysis). Shape only, no error results yet.
  > - Source: open-llm-leaderboard/results (raw lm-eval result JSON per model run), commit aa81ecc38fdc5708254b833923368970efdf5ef5; 10,504 result files for 4,507 model dirs. Cells = per-subtask main metric x100: 24 BBH subtasks, 3 GPQA, 7 MATH-hard subjects, 3 MuSR, IFEval (prompt-level strict), MMLU-Pro (aggregate only) = **N = 39 benchmarks**; the latest file with all 39 per model gives **M = 4,507 models, 0% missing** (dense; random holes can be added for the missing-rate sweep). Models are fine-tunes/merges of open weights evaluated by one harness (Feb-Mar 2025): single evaluation date, so no temporal split; strength split is possible.
  > - Groups: uploader orgs are a poor family proxy (717 uploaders; merges of one base spread over many). I use a name-stem family list (qwen2.5, llama-3, gemma-2, ...; fallback uploader): 475 groups, largest 9.1% of models (qwen2.5 408). Heuristic, stated as such. Top singular value carries 62% of standardised variance (second 9%), i.e. a strong general factor.
  > - k grid for it: |T| = 12 (stratified by type; IFEval and MMLU-Pro are single tasks and stay in the pool), k in {1,2,3,5,8,13}. This meets G2 (N >= 20) for a claim of its own; the 'LLM' wording in the title is then decidable once its C/T results are in. Scope caveat to state: these are small open models, one harness, dense matrix; not frontier models.
  > - Running now: C/T stage B on the MTEB matrix (50 shared splits, all rules) and stage A + C/T stage B on this matrix; the R_m \ S results stay as the labelled secondary, PREREG Deviation 3 (post-result, dated) records the change. Results land as results/ct_* files in experiment-repo main.
